field.label: Listen Address
field.help: IP address to bind the MCP HTTP listener to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces (not recommended — prefer the management address).

field.label: Listen Port
field.help: TCP port for the MCP HTTP listener.

field.label: Transport
field.help: MCP transport mode. HTTP for network clients (Claude Code via mcp-remote); stdio for local pipe.

field.label: Auth Token
field.help: Bearer token that MCP clients must present. Auto-generated on first enable if left blank. Clients connect with header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".
